procedures.lightning-grave:
Action; one perceived enemy within120feet and line of effect; V/S/F; base17RP. KEEP the lightning seal and10d8 on moving/acting, not unconditional entry damage. NEW: initial DEX save; success establishes nothing, failure establishes a one-use visible seal for60 elapsed seconds without concentration. Damage immunity does not make an independent mark immune; an actual source blocking the mark prevents admission. One same-caster mark per target; a genuinely established replacement ends that caster's old mark. A saved/countered new nonconcentration cast replaces nothing; different casters retain independent marks.
NEW trigger: after marking, the first new deliberate Action, Bonus Action or Reaction commitment, or voluntary movement segment before its first step, commits the discharge. A voluntary teleport commitment counts as acting. Forced displacement, automatic breathing, falling, ordinary no-action speech, a preexisting underway commitment and scheduled administrative events do not trigger it. Marked means neither Stunned nor forbidden to act. Serialize multiple live marks by actual application order. Consume the mark before callbacks, create one current original-caster recipient root and roll10d8 lightning; the discharge itself has no second save. Defenses apply normally even when they prevent all HP loss; that committed mark remains spent. Damage occurs after the triggering action's genuine commitment and before its first main outcome; the originating paid action is not refunded. If its actor cannot meet its continuing real requirements after damage/incapacity, that native outcome fails; do not automatically cancel all unrelated already-committed spell events or revive them.
The target-attached seal is the suppression locus. While genuinely suppressed it observes no triggers, grants no queued discharge and retains its clock; future new behavior after resumption can trigger once. If permitted discharge commits but its payload is then prevented, mark consumption remains. Expiry at t0+60, actual mark dispel/removal or target death/removal ends harmlessly. No attachment to the corpse, rearm on healing or damage from expiry. No new Reaction or action cost for the automatic seal trigger. Ended records are never restored.
procedures.pyroclasm:

Ordinary sloped floors qualify; a vertical wall does not. The ground patch follows those exact original world locations, not future flowing terrain or a moved platform. Destruction/removal of a contributing support removes its patch portion; no replacement surface is invented. A cast without such ground still has its initial burst but creates no ground.
Only actual support-contact with an operative patch exposes a body; merely being overhead/flying or horizontally overlapping does not. NEW ground packet2d6 fire, no save, at a recipient's first subsequent actual contact or regular START in contact, at most once per named Pyroclasm-ground family per recipient/numbered round across casters. Recipients in contact at creation have the creation-round ground opportunity marked spent WITHOUT another2d6; the initial10d6 is not doubled by establishment. New later entrants can take the ground packet. Leaving/reentering, extra turns, new casts and suppressed resume do not reset the family ledger. On simultaneous eligible patches choose earliest application/stable ID. Without regular schedule retain a scene six-second exposure cycle and map it without reset; an attached companion uses only its real phase beginning for that check, never an extra turn.
Each real ground packet creates a fresh original-caster root using current source state. Local suppression excludes that portion before admission and does not spend a wholly prevented opportunity; a body actually admitted spends the opportunity even if fire defenses prevent damage. Whole generating-anchor suppression suppresses this source's patches for its original remaining time, not an ending/refill. Full dispel ends the whole captured source; local suppression alone does not. No attached Burning, spread, heat, smoke, difficult terrain, harvesting or mundane combustion is added. Underwater/nonflammable support may carry this expressly magical fire if its actual source protections permit; it creates no steam/evaporation or fuel inventory. End at+60 with no final pulse or damage after ground removal.
procedures.frost-reaver:
Action; one perceived creature within120feet and line of effect; V/S/F;17RP. KEEP8d8 cold and slowed UNTIL HEALED. NEW initial CON: full8d8 on failure, floor-half on success. Roll once and use actual defenses/life. Failure independently attempts one half-Speed rider, floor applied through actual strongest-adverse-Speed arbitration; it neither changes actions, AC, DEX, concentration permissions nor imposes the other spell named Slow. Successful save prevents this rider. Cold immunity or zero damage does not prevent the separately eligible rider; actual movement-effect prevention may. If the recipient ceases to be an eligible creature through its damage lifecycle, no rider is placed on remains.
The rider is nonconcentration with NO replacement one-minute cap. NEW healed endpoint: after admission, one genuinely eligible normal-HP healing application whose positive healing is legally allowed ends every still-live Frost Reaver rider on that recipient, even when the actual maximum/Critical ceiling leaves no HP to add. A healing application wholly prohibited or invalid does not qualify. A real positive normal-HP direct restoration/regeneration or source-authorized nonmagical healing/recovery qualifies on its actual event, not on an announced intention. Temporary HP, damage prevention, stabilization without healing, an ordinary object repair, a failed potion, hypothetical rest and a no-HP state edit do not. A full-HP target can therefore be cured without manufacturing HP or a new free healing source. HP eligibility/consumption remains the healer's real rule.
Each independent cast has its own record. Half-Speed is not multiplicatively stacked with itself or other competing slows; the strongest actual adverse-Speed reduction applies before later systemic multipliers. New acquisition/recast does not convert the condition to permanent anatomy or a damage-over-time effect. Recipient-local suppression removes its expression while preserving the until-healed record. A qualifying healing event still permanently ends the record while suppressed. Genuine dispel/removal or target death/removal also ends it. An independently live different slow remains after Frost Reaver is cured; cure never refunds prior movement or concentration checks.

Suppression leaves the paid clock/charge record; a manual or automatic detonation while the anchor manifestation is suppressed consumes it harmlessly, without queue/refund or root. procedures.prismatic-spray:

Rows1–3: 8d6 fire/acid/lightning respectively, DEX full/half, no condition. Row4:6d8 cold, CON full/half; failed save independently applies Speed−10 until the next FUTURE regular target END or application+6 when no such schedule. Row5:6d8 thunder, CON full/half; failure independently applies Deafened to that same finite endpoint. Row6:6d6 psychic, WIS full/half; failure independently applies Frightened of the original caster to that endpoint, using actual source-location knowledge, not a locator. Each damage/condition is independently defended; success halves damage and prevents the row's condition. Real death/removal prevents a new creature rider. Same named penalties do not add magnitude; independent clocks remain. These short riders create no repeat save, special extra turn or opportunity to refresh a source through reentry. Suppression of an extant rider suspends expression, not its original deadline/hard history. Actual removal ends only its own application. No permanent anatomy, item damage, loot or repeating cone.
procedures.whirlwind:

Stop at the first real placement obstruction, occupied body, actual anchor limit or the center; no co-occupancy, tunnel, teleport, collision packet or forced vertical launch. A current real form/position change before its move requires its actual body/path revalidation, not a new target scan.
An actual source preventing displacement prevents only its own pull, not damage. Forced movement provokes no ordinary opportunity attack or movement benefit. A grappler moves alone; when actual maintained reach breaks the grip ends rather than dragging an unselected body. A source explicitly transporting the other body keeps its own rule; Whirlwind grants none. A flying creature can be pulled but retains actual flight; unsupported nonflying endpoints begin ordinary Falling with the genuine marker, not immediate invented impact. A living NullDisabled creature can retain identity if its lifecycle allows; dead corpse remains are not creature pull targets.
The wind ends after the finite batch and one pull per eligible identity. No recurring10d6, object vacuum, weather, obscuration, harvested air, extra attack or persistent cyclone is added. Local prevented applications are omitted before batch admission; later field removal cannot undo completed movement/damage.
